description: List tracked competitor apps for one of your apps, with how many more the plan allows — and `suggested`: up to ten rivals the account does not track yet, ranked by how many of the app's own search terms they sit in the top ten for. Works on an app with no keywords: its listing is read for terms and the store is crawled for them. Read `suggested_basis.terms_pending` before calling a short list complete. Suggestions can persist shared keyword records and queue background crawls. Suggested apps are not added to your competitor watchlist.

app_id.description: Apptail app id for one of YOUR apps — get it from get_account. Not the numeric id in an App Store URL (that is apple_app_id).

name: get_competitors

app_id.description: The app these rivals are tracked against.

competitors.description: Apps tracked as competitors of the given app. Empty if none are tracked yet.

app_id.description: Apptail app ID. This is the `app_id` every other tool expects.

apple_app_id.description: Apple's own numeric app ID, as it appears in App Store URLs. Not interchangeable with `app_id`.

console_url.description: Where to open this app in the AppTail console — the owner's own dashboard when `is_mine`, the research view otherwise. Null where this environment serves no console. End an answer about an app with it.

country.description: Storefront the metrics below were read from. Defaults to `primary_country`.

currency.description: ISO code of the currency `price` is in, derived from `country`. A price without it is a number, not an amount — several storefronts print a "$" and mean different money.

icon.description: Absolute URL of the app icon.

is_mine.description: True when this is one of the asking account's own apps. Null when the call carried no account — get_top_charts answers without a token — which is "not known here", not "no".

is_tracked_competitor.description: True when the account already tracks this app as a competitor of one of theirs. False on a high-ranking rival is a suggestion worth making: add_competitors starts watching it. Null when the call carried no account.

listing_storefronts.description: One storefront per language the listing is localized in, `primary_country` first, e.g. ["ru", "us"]. An app published in two languages is searched for in two storefronts; keyword discovery and tracking are per storefront, so cover each of these rather than only `primary_country`.

name.description: The app's title **as published in `country`** — the string a shopper in that storefront reads, which is also the string Apple indexes. It is not a translation of one canonical name: an app localised for Mexico has a different title there, and `get_app(country: "mx")` returning the US one is what makes an agent report a localised app as "not localized". Falls back to the app's canonical name when this storefront has not been crawled yet, and is null only while a freshly imported app is still being processed.

price.description: Download price in `country`, in that storefront's own currency and in major units — 9.99, never 999. 0 means free, which is what most apps are; `currency` names the money. Null when this storefront has no listing on file.

primary_category.description: Store category ID. Pass this as `category` to get_top_charts.

primary_country.description: Lowercase ISO country code of the app's main storefront, e.g. "us".

rating_average.description: Mean star rating (1-5) in `country`. Null if the app has no ratings there yet.

store.description: Which store the app belongs to.

subtitle.description: The subtitle under the title in `country` — thirty characters Apple indexes as heavily as the title, and the field most competitors leave generic. Null when the storefront listing has none, which is itself worth saying: an empty subtitle is unspent keyword weight.

limit.description: How many competitors this plan allows per app. -1 means unlimited.

remaining.description: Slots left before add_competitors is refused. Null when the plan is unlimited.

suggested.description: Rivals worth tracking that are not on the list, strongest evidence first: apps in the top ten of the terms this app competes on (tracked, already ranked for, or read off its listing when it has neither), never the account's own apps, never one already tracked, never one hidden from the Landscape. Offer them with their `sample_terms`; add with add_competitors only when asked. Empty when the app has nothing to derive from — say that rather than "no competitors exist".

app_id.description: Apptail app id. Pass it to add_competitors to track it, or to get_app for the listing.

best_place.description: Its highest place among those terms. Null on a `similar` row.

sample_terms.description: Up to three of the terms it ranks best on — name them when recommending it, so the owner can see why.

source.description: `serp` — seen in the top ten of the app's terms, which is the evidence `terms` counts. `similar` — the App Store lists it beside the app and no results page has shown it: a weaker reason, appended only when the pages named fewer rivals than asked for.

terms.description: How many of the app's corpus terms this rival sits in the top ten for, over the last two weeks. Zero on a `similar` row. This is the number the list is sorted by: a rival on five pages is a stronger suggestion than one on one.

suggested_basis.description: What the suggestions were derived from. Null when the app is not one of the account's own — a suggestion needs your terms to read.

country.description: The storefront whose results pages were read. Suggestions are per storefront.

terms.description: Corpus size: how many terms the pages were read for.

terms_from_listing.description: Terms a model read off the listing because the two above were too few. Zero when they were enough.

terms_measured.description: Terms with a results page in the last two weeks — the ones `terms` on each row is counted out of.

terms_pending.description: Terms queued for a crawl and not yet read. **Above zero means the list is partial and will grow** — say so, and offer to look again in a minute rather than presenting it as complete.

terms_ranked.description: Terms the app already holds a top-10 place for without tracking them.

terms_tracked.description: Of those, terms the account tracks for this app.

total.description: How many untracked apps the pages named in all, before the cap.

truncated.description: True when `suggested` is shorter than `total`. get_landscape has the whole niche.

title: Get Competitors
